item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 02/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Temperatures over the region will rise slightly. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather over Guangdong will be slightly cooler with a few rain patches in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 03/01 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly fine. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 17 - 21 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
